name: iKnow Church
shortDescription: UK church management software with published member-based pricing and supplier documentation for giving and Gift Aid claims.
suitableContexts: UK churches wanting an all-features member-based subscription

pricing.summary: Published GBP pricing is based on the number of adult church members and includes VAT and the listed feature set.

startingPrice.qualifier: Fewer than 50 adult church members; supplier pricing includes VAT

importExport: Donation reports in PDF or CSV

editorial.assessment: iKnow Church supplies unusually specific UK finance and Gift Aid information. A church should confirm the exact modules, transaction charges, migration process and security arrangements for its own use case.
bestFor: UK churches that want administration and giving in one service
Churches that prefer pricing linked to regular adult members
strengths: Supplier documentation covers HMRC Gift Aid submission
limitations: Gift Aid submissions and payment processing can carry additional charges
Data hosting and accessibility information have not yet been verified for this listing

seo.description: Independent iKnow Church profile covering verified UK pricing, Gift Aid, giving and church management information, with clear caveats.
